fields.help_en:
When Resource Type is set to public resources, or when Resource Quota is set to upfront general-purpose compute resources (with 2 or more CPU cores and 4 GB or more memory, or configured with a GPU):


Each instance is provided with a free 100 GiB system cloud disk quota for persistent storage. If the instance is stopped for more than 15 days, the content of the cloud disk is cleared. The cloud disk supports capacity expansion. For specific expansion pricing, refer to the console interface.

<warning>

Capacity reduction is not supported after expansion. Expand the capacity as needed.

After expansion, the entire system cloud disk (free and paid portions) is no longer subject to the 15-day release limit upon instance stop, but continues to incur fees.

When the instance is deleted, the system cloud disk is released in synchronization. Ensure necessary data backup before deletion.

</warning>

If you require permanent storage, you can configure Dataset Mounting or add OSS, NAS, or CPFS paths in Storage Path Mounting
fields.help_zh:
当资源类型选择公共资源，或当资源配额选择预付费通用计算资源（CPU核数≥2且内存≥4G，或配置GPU）时：


每个实例会赠送100 GiB免费系统盘额度，用于持久化存储。如果实例停机超过15天，云盘的内容将被清空。云盘支持扩容，具体扩容价格以控制台界面为准。

<warning>

扩容后不支持缩容，请按需操作扩容。

扩容后整块系统盘（免费+付费），不再受到停机15天释放的限制，但会持续产生费用。

实例删除，系统盘同步释放，删除前请确保必要数据备份。

</warning>

如果您需要永久性存储，可以配置数据集挂载，或在存储路径挂载中添加OSS、NAS、CPFS路径

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The storage corresponding to the working directory. You can mount cloud disks or datasets in Datasets to the /mnt/workspace working directory at the same time. OSS datasets and dynamically mounted datasets are not supported.

Valid values:
rootfsCloudDisk: Mounts the cloud disk to the working directory.
The mount path of the dataset: The MountPath of the dataset in Datasets, such as /mnt/data. Datasets in URI format can only be specified in this way.
The ID of the dataset, such as d-vsqjvs****rp5l206u. If the same dataset is mounted to multiple paths, the first path is selected. This method is not recommended. We recommend that you use the mount path.

If this parameter is left empty:
If the instance uses a cloud disk, the cloud disk is selected by default.
If no cloud disk is available, the first NAS or CPFS dataset is selected as the working directory.
If no cloud disk, NAS, or CPFS working directory is available, the host space is used
parameters.help_zh:
指定工作目录对应的存储，支持将云盘或Datasets中的数据集同时挂载到/mnt/workspace工作目录，不支持OSS数据集和动态挂载的数据集。

目前可以填写：
rootfsCloudDisk： 将云盘挂载到工作目录。
数据集的挂载路径：Datasets中数据集的MountPath，如/mnt/data，uri格式的数据集只支持通过该方式指定。
数据集的id，如d-vsqjvs****rp5l206u，假如同一个数据集挂载到多个路径，会选择第一个，不建议使用该方式，建议使用挂载路径。

假如为空：
假如实例使用了云盘，会默认选择云盘。
假如没有云盘，会选择第一个nas或cpfs数据集作为工作目录。
假如没有云盘，且没有nas或cpfs工作目录，会使用宿主机空间
